messages:
Emily: Hey team — due date is in ~2 weeks. Planning to do remote-first for the initial 2 weeks after the baby is born. Is that covered under our parental leave / phased return policy? Also who do I notify for equipment shipping and payroll handoffs?

Michelle: Congrats!! :tada: You can absolutely do a temporary remote return. Quick checklist: 1) File your parental leave in HiBob with your expected return date, 2) complete the 'temporary remote addendum' (link: <https://hr.redwood/remote-addendum>), 3) if you want company equipment shipped, submit an IT request. I'll DM you the addendum now. If your leave is paid parental leave there should be no payroll impact; unpaid leave may adjust pay — payroll team will confirm when you file.

Emily: Awesome — thanks Michelle. Do I need manager approval before filing or can I file and loop Jordan?

Jordan: No problem from my side, Emily. Please file and tag me — I’ll approve the phased-return plan. Small ask: for the first week can we keep you off oncall and reduce meeting load? I’ll cover demos and pairings.

Ben: IT here — we can ship a standing desk adapter + monitor + dock to your home. Fill the IT form (link: <https://it.redwood/requests>) and mark priority 'parental-return'. Shipping ETA 3-5 business days once approved. If you want us to pre-stage equipment so it arrives on your expected return date, say so and include preferred address.

Emily: Perfect. Can you pre-stage to arrive on my return date? I'll put the address in the form.

Sara: Quick note from benefits — if you plan to use backup childcare occasionally during the phased return, you may be eligible for the backup-care stipend. Save receipts and submit via Expensify under 'backup childcare' within 60 days. Link to policy: <https://benefits.redwood/backup-care>.

Michelle: Filing note — Emily, if anything changes after the birth (early/late), update HiBob ASAP. People Ops will issue a formal combine-of-leave-and-remote note in your employee record. I’ll create the HR ticket once you've submitted the addendum.

Emily: Thanks everyone — filing it now and tagging Jordan. Appreciate the pre-stage option, Ben. :heart:
